name: sidebar-pane-void
title: Fix sidebar pane void: allocatePanes must always fill the pool
description: Saved user pane px are honored as-is; when their sum is smaller than the current pane-view pool, allocatePanes leaves the leftover unassigned and a void appears below the last section. Fix allocation to always sum to pool, and stop persisting user sizes on a no-move sash click.
creator: opencode
